outer.target_winding: k+1 of the source winding (floor(s)); w027 has no outer and w010 no inner target in this mesh

inner.target_winding: k-1 of the source winding (floor(s)); w027 has no outer and w010 no inner target in this mesh

field_rule: 32 x 32 cells of the tile; source = nearest grid vertex to the cell centre; value = facing canvas (row, col) px, NaN where none
